title: LT Foods buys US brand Maya Kaimal

timeline.title: LT Foods buys US brand Maya Kaimal
timeline.line: US unit to acquire the sauces and curries maker for $5.8 million
more: Deal at enterprise value of $5.8 million, cash-free and debt-free
Shares up as much as 8–10% intraday; reports differ
Strengthens its ready-to-eat range in the US

src.title: LT Foods Shares Jump 8% after $5.8 Million Maya Kaimal Acquisition
